name: Arisa Crain Femiluna
original_name: アリサ・クレイン・フェミルナ
source:
Class: 3rd year, 11th class
Likes: Bitter chocolate, basking in the sun

Arisa is a girl from France who is a mix between American, British and Japanese, and a member of NOA. She has mastered 7 languages, has been able to skip grades because of her genius brain abroad and is proficient in martial arts. Despite her mission having a 117% chance of success, [url=/c7209]Hotaru[/url] is ready for everything to fail. Arisa often worries about her bed-ridden sister [url=/c7212]Sarasa[/url] to a such extent that she's almost sticking to her like glue. Because of this, [url=/c34457]Hayakawa-sensei[/url] calls them "Yuri Sisters".
